notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - Visual Update for monsters and backgrounds
notes.content:
- New backgrounds;
- New sprites for some monsters (a few are still the same).

This update is part of our saga to create RPG Maker games with original assets. Stay tuned and join [url=https://discord.gg/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] to report any bugs!

Cheers,

Male Doll Team

tags.feature: - New sprites for some monsters (a few are still the same).

notes.title: Cumming Hotel 1.01 (New improvements and bugs fixed)

tags.feature: Garlic respawns in the Horny Tower;
Newspapers with different news for each day;
Young Sorcerer's Quest (now you can save her dog in the Horny Tower and learn a special skill - only after Kyle reaches level 10);
Dushi's Quest (now you can sell 10 tomatoes to earn extra money);
People recognizing Kyle after he starts to perform at the bar and the Orcs starting to appear in Magnolia Village;
New mini-events like a Lost Bather and an Undecided Adventurer;
Kyle's 'sprite' removed during the Horny Tower hunt;

tags.balance_change: Holy Cut damage reduced, now it gives only extra damage - opposite to the 'instakill' potential from the first game version;

tags.feature: 9 different small dialogs for Bruce and Kyle after their workday (5 for Bruce and 4 for Kyle) - now you can discover a little bit more about their feelings/past life;

Insertion of a Game Manual - now you can understand some aspects of how the game works such as what Couple's Desire and Trust means in a practical way and how they can impact to the gameplay. If you have already started the game, you can get a Manual by interacting with the Red Crystal close to Lady Ursula’s shop;
‘Work Board’ - now you can access services requirements and workdays available for all 'potential clients' in the game through a board close to the main desk of the hotel.
